review:
Hot to Burn – 7 Deadly Free Spins is a 5x3 classic with cherries, sevens and BARs. Every winning combination removes the lowest-paying symbol and awards a respin, and on the seventh consecutive respin the 7 Deadly Free Spins round begins with a 2x multiplier on every win.

Free spins can also be triggered by three scatters, which give seven free spins with the six lowest-paying symbols removed for the whole round. Pragmatic Play states wins up to 4,000x. The RTP is 96.54%. A fiery classic with a clever respin ladder.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
